kvCache.title: KV cache estimate
kvCache.titleHint: Computed from this checkpoint's cache layout, the tokens and sequences below, and the KV precision you pick — not a value the catalog states.

familyBasis.uniform_layers: Head-based because this checkpoint reports no kv_lora_rank or qk_rope_head_dim and no layer kind that caches differently. A control plane that does not report those fields yet looks the same from here.
familyBasis.latent_widths: Latent because this checkpoint reports kv_lora_rank and qk_rope_head_dim, which describe what an MLA layer caches.
familyBasis.sliding_layer_types: Mixed because layer_types names sliding_attention layers alongside full ones, and the checkpoint states the window they cap at.
familyBasis.linear_layer_types: Hybrid because layer_types names linear_attention layers, which hold one fixed-size recurrent state per sequence instead of a key and value per token.
familyBasis.compress_ratios: Sparse because this checkpoint states compress_ratios, a per-layer schedule of how many tokens each layer folds into one cached slot. The head fields it also states describe what attention is computed over, not what is cached.

sourceHints.derived: Computed from other checkpoint values by a documented convention
sourceHints.manual: Typed in by a user, overriding what the checkpoint states
sourceHints.unstated: This value states no provenance, so it is not known to come from the checkpoint
sourceHints.constant: A fixed factor of the formula, not a value from the checkpoint
sourceHints.deployment: Comes from this deployment's engine arguments, not from the checkpoint.

kvCache.layerTypes: Cannot estimate: this checkpoint states {{types}} layers, and none of the formulas here describes what such a layer caches.
kvCache.noModelInfo: Cannot estimate: nothing is known about this checkpoint.
kvCache.invalidInput: Enter a whole number of tokens and sequences, and pick a KV precision.
kvCache.notPerToken: does not grow with the sequence
kvCache.recurrentPrecisionHint: Linear-attention state is held at this width. Its short-convolution history stays BF16.
kvCache.indexerPrecisionHint: Sparse-attention indexer entries are held separately from the KV cache.
kvCache.compressionRates: Cannot estimate: this checkpoint compresses at a rate ({{rates}}) whose cache layout has not been established from any released checkpoint, so whether those layers carry an indexer is unknown.

hints.name: 1-32 lowercase letters, digits or '-'. It identifies this source's users and cannot be changed later.

hints.clientSecret: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
hints.insecureSkipVerify: Accepts any server certificate. Use only for testing.
hints.caCert: CA that signed the directory's certificate. Leave empty to use the system trust store.
hints.oidcCaCert: Trusted in addition to the system trust store, for a provider with a private CA.
hints.scopes: Separated by spaces. Must include openid; empty means openid profile email.
hints.redirectUrl: The public URL of neutree's OIDC callback. Register exactly this URL with the provider.
hints.allowedRedirects: One URL per line. Where a login may return to; must include this UI's address.
hints.adminEquivalent: Whoever can create or change an identity source decides who its users are. Treat these permissions as administrator access.
hints.syncEnabled: Reads the whole directory on a schedule and creates departments, teams and users from it. Users disabled or removed in the directory are deactivated.
hints.orgUnitBaseDn: Organizational units under this DN become departments. Empty syncs no departments.
hints.groupBaseDn: Groups under this DN become teams. Empty syncs no teams.
hints.disabledUserFilter: Selects the users disabled in the directory. For Active Directory use (userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2). Empty treats no user as disabled.
hints.userListFilter: Selects every user to sync. Empty uses the user filter with {username} replaced by *.
hints.pageSize: Entries per page when reading the directory. Empty means 500.
hints.syncNowDisabled: Turn on organization sync in the settings first.
hints.syncNowPaused: Enable the identity source first. Its sync is paused while it is disabled.

status.classInfo: Informational — the server acknowledged the request and is still processing it.

description.400: Bad request — the request was malformed or rejected by the gateway.
description.401: Unauthorized — the API key is missing or invalid.
description.403: Forbidden — the API key is not allowed to access this resource.
description.404: Not found — the requested model or endpoint does not exist.
description.408: Request timeout — the client did not finish sending the request in time.
description.429: Too many requests — a rate or quota limit was exceeded.
description.499: Client closed request — the client disconnected before the response completed.
description.500: Internal server error — the gateway or upstream failed unexpectedly.
description.502: Bad gateway — the upstream returned an invalid response.
description.503: Service unavailable — no healthy upstream was available to serve the request.
description.504: Gateway timeout — the upstream did not respond within the time limit.
